raw_segments.text: "'Ah,' cried Mr. Pumblechook, leaning back in his chair, quite flaccid with admiration.
"'That's the way you know him, sir.
I don't know who Sir was, but he certainly was not I, and there was no third person present.
That's the way you know the noble-minded, sir, ever forgiving and ever affable.
It might,' said the serval Pumblechook, putting down his untasted glass in a hurry and getting
up again, to a common person have the appearance of repeating.
